# Forsured

> Forsured is construction insurance compliance software. It checks every contractor certificate of insurance (COI) against a project's insurance requirements, flags coverage and endorsement gaps, brings the contractor's broker into the fix, and keeps checking for the life of the project. Built for general contractors, trade contractors and insurance brokers in the United States.

Key facts:
- Website: https://forsured.ai
- Contact: hello@forsured.ai
- Offer: a free COI risk check. Send one project's requirements and a contractor COI or two, and Forsured shows every gap it finds.
- Integrations: Procore (available for early access customers).

## Product

- [Forsured home](https://forsured.ai/): what Forsured does, how the review works, and who it's for (general contractors, brokers, trade contractors)
- [Free COI risk check](https://forsured.ai/#demo): send one project's requirements and a contractor COI

## Blog

- [What does "per written contract" mean on an additional insured endorsement?](https://forsured.ai/blog/per-written-contract-additional-insured/): Blanket additional insured endorsements add whoever a written contract requires. Whose contract, signed when, and saying what decides whether you're covered. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/per-written-contract-additional-insured/index.md
- [Can parametric insurance cover weather delays on a construction project?](https://forsured.ai/blog/parametric-builders-risk-weather-gap/): Builder's risk pays for physical damage, not for days lost to cold, heat or wind. A CRC panel explained how parametric cover fills that gap. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/parametric-builders-risk-weather-gap/index.md
- [What does primary and noncontributory mean on a COI?](https://forsured.ai/blog/primary-and-noncontributory/): Primary and noncontributory decides whose policy pays first when a contractor's work causes a loss. What it means, which endorsement creates it, and what to check. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/primary-and-noncontributory/index.md
- [What we heard at our first IRMI Construction Risk Conference](https://forsured.ai/blog/forsured-at-irmi-crc-2026/): Forsured spent IRMI's 2026 Construction Risk Conference talking COIs with brokers, carriers and contractors. Five things we heard, and what we're doing about them. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/forsured-at-irmi-crc-2026/index.md
- [A COI on file isn't proof of coverage](https://forsured.ai/blog/compliance-isnt-coverage/): A certificate of insurance shows what a contractor bought on one day. Here's what it can't tell you, and what to check against your project requirements instead. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/compliance-isnt-coverage/index.md
- [3 takeaways from day 2 of IRMI's Construction Risk Conference](https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-crc-2026-day-2-takeaways/): Additional insured endorsements, prequalification as a snapshot, and insurance data you can't search. What we were digging into on day 2 at IRMI CRC 2026. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-crc-2026-day-2-takeaways/index.md
- [IRMI is rewriting its design-build risk and insurance guide](https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-design-build-guide-update/): IRMI picked American Global to rewrite its Design-Build Risk and Insurance guide. What the update covers, and what design-build means for contractor COI review. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-design-build-guide-update/index.md
- [How to check a contractor COI against your project requirements](https://forsured.ai/blog/how-to-check-a-contractor-coi/): A practical checklist for checking a contractor certificate of insurance against one project's requirements: coverages, limits, dates and endorsements. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/how-to-check-a-contractor-coi/index.md
- [3 takeaways from day 1 of IRMI's Construction Risk Conference](https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-crc-2026-day-1-takeaways/): Crowded bids and thin margins, umbrella rates still rising, and contractor management turning into an underwriting factor. What stuck with us from day 1 at IRMI CRC 2026. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/irmi-crc-2026-day-1-takeaways/index.md
- [What the 2027 construction insurance outlook means for contractor COIs](https://forsured.ai/blog/construction-insurance-2027-renewal-outlook/): WTW forecasts construction umbrella and excess rates up 5% to 15% in 2027. Here's the full outlook by line, and why it raises the stakes on contractor COI review. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/blog/construction-insurance-2027-renewal-outlook/index.md

## Contractor insurance requirements by state

- [Contractor insurance requirements by state](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/): Contractor insurance requirements for all 50 states and DC: workers' comp thresholds, license insurance minimums and anti-indemnity rules, with sources. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/index.md
- [Alabama contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/alabama/): workers' comp required at 5 employees; new homes 1; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: No general statute. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/alabama/index.md
- [Alaska contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/alaska/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: $50K/$100K BI, $20K PD; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/alaska/index.md
- [Arizona contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/arizona/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence; broader for private. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/arizona/index.md
- [Arkansas contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/arkansas/): workers' comp required at 3 employees; building work 2; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/arkansas/index.md
- [California contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/california/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: Workers' comp on file; LLCs $1M; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence; active negligence on most private jobs. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/california/index.md
- [Colorado contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/colorado/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: Own negligence, even in part; reaches additional insured. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/colorado/index.md
- [Connecticut contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/connecticut/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: Own negligence, even in part. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/connecticut/index.md

Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/delaware/index.md
- [District of Columbia contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/district-of-columbia/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: No statewide minimum; anti-indemnity statute voids: No general statute. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/district-of-columbia/index.md
- [Florida contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/florida/): workers' comp required at 4 employees; construction 1; license insurance minimum: $300K liability, $50K PD (GC); anti-indemnity statute voids: Own negligence, unless capped. - [Hawaii contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/hawaii/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: Liability required; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/hawaii/index.md
- [Idaho contractor insurance requirements](https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/idaho/): workers' comp required at 1 employee; license insurance minimum: $300K single limit; anti-indemnity statute voids: Sole negligence. Markdown: https://forsured.ai/coi-requirements/idaho/index.md
